name: JFTECH
recent: JF Technology 在2026年11月23日公布季度业绩，录得净利 RM6.5 million（程序数据为 RM4.836 million，对应期间 2026-06-30），并宣布每股 0.50 sen 的单层中期股息。公司同时推进每 5 股现有普通股送 2 张凭单的免费凭单计划，Bursa Securities 已于 11 月 16 日批准最多 388,011,656 张凭单及等量新股的上市。此外，公司于 11 月 23 日宣布委任 Siew Chun Fai 为首席财务官，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。
notable: 宣布每股 0.50 sen 的单层中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 7 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 22 日。
Bursa Securities 批准最多 388,011,656 张凭单及等量新股的上市，涉及每 5 股送 2 张凭单的免费凭单计划。
委任 Siew Chun Fai 为首席财务官，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。
risks: 免费凭单计划涉及最多 388,011,656 张凭单及等量新股，未来凭单行使可能带来股权稀释。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为 RM27.403 million，环比增长 18.2%，同比增长 113.0%；净利为 RM4.836 million，环比增长 51.5%，同比增长 436.7%；净利率为 17.6%，高于上一季度的 13.8%。

recent_en: JF Technology announced its quarterly results on 23 November 2026, reporting a net profit of RM6.5 million (program data shows RM4.836 million for the period ended 30 June 2026), and declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.50 sen per share. The company is also proceeding with a proposed bonus issue of 2 free warrants for every 5 existing ordinary shares; Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 388,011,656 warrants and an equal number of new shares on 16 November. Separately, the company announced on 23 November the appointment of Siew Chun Fai as CFO effective 1 January 2027.
notable_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 7 December 2026 and payment date on 22 December 2026.
Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 388,011,656 warrants and an equal number of new shares under the proposed bonus issue of 2 free warrants for every 5 existing shares.
Appointed Siew Chun Fai as Chief Financial Officer effective 1 January 2027.
risks_en: The proposed bonus issue of warrants involves up to 388,011,656 warrants and an equal number of new shares, and future exercise of the warrants may lead to shareholding dilution.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM27.403 million, up 18.2% QoQ and 113.0% YoY; net income was RM4.836 million, up 51.5% QoQ and 436.7% YoY; net margin was 17.6%, higher than 13.8% in the previous quarter.
